title: Eval system: data flow detection
description:
Add Layer 2 evaluation for deterministic data-flow output after the shared evaluator lands.

Blocked only on DATAP-c7dd46 shared evaluator contract. Once c7dd46 lands, proceeds in PARALLEL with DATAP-f3feec — not sequential after f3feec. Real benchmark cases from DATAP-b17f92 supplement committed smoke fixtures when available (optional enrichment, not a start blocker).

The adapter receives both components and dataFlows. Resolve sourceComponentId and targetComponentId through the component index, create a canonical edge identity, and normalize sourceLocation plus sourceLocations into evidence. The current type does not expose sourceComponentName, targetComponentName, or evidence fields.

Evaluate source, target, flow type, and location. Use flow.type as the deterministic label unless a separately verified deterministic stage populates dataCategories. Do not claim data-category label accuracy from fields that are only optional or AI-enriched.

Use committed smoke fixtures for CI and exhaustively annotated benchmark scopes for true precision. Preserve exact per-file unread handling. Zero scanner changes unless current output proves insufficient and that scope change is separately approved.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
## Eval system: Data flow detection (Layer 2)

Follow-up PR. Still zero scanner changes — data flows are existing public output (scanResult.dataFlows).

### What it evaluates

The scanner detects connections between components (e.g., "PaymentsController imports Database module" → data flow edge). This layer evaluates whether the scanner finds the right connections and correctly categorizes the data flowing through them.

### Adapter

Maps scanResult.dataFlows → ReportedFinding[]:

```typescript
const findings: ReportedFinding[] = result.scanResult.dataFlows.map(f => ({
  name: `${f.sourceComponentName} → ${f.targetComponentName}`,
  labels: f.dataCategories ?? [],
  evidence: f.evidence ?? [],
}));
```

### Cases

- Recall: "expect a flow from component A to component B at file F line L"
- Precision: "expect NO flow from A to B at file F line L"
- Label accuracy: "expect the flow to carry data category X" (e.g., user_identity_direct)

The scoring engine is the same as Layer 1 — location-based matching. The adapter handles the relationship-to-location mapping.

### Scope

- Zero src/ changes
- No LLM (enableAiInference: false)
- New adapter + cases under tests/eval/layers/data-flows/
- Follow-up to the Layer 1 PR (depends on the shared scoring engine landing first)
